release_notes: Audited and upgraded overall Android UI responsiveness across Display Size settings (Small, Default, Large), Font Scale settings, screen resolutions, and Gesture vs. 3-Button Navigation while preserving Pockeva's compact sizing.
Redesigned the Settings Home Screen Widgets section into 3 clean options: Default Individual Wallet Widget, Add Widget, and How to Add & Manage Widgets.

Added Add Widget selection sheet and live Widget Preview bottom sheet powered by local Pockeva data with Compact, Standard, and Expanded size presets plus native Home Screen pinning and manual fallback guide.
Aligned the Currency selector vertically with the Principal Amount input field in Loan, Lent, and Borrow sheets.
Locked the Loan Type selector (Lent / Borrowed / Bank/NGO) with a clear disabled state when editing existing loans.
